ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
benefits_summary: Direct monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 transferred to the bank account of eligible women in Maharashtra to promote economic independence and health.
exclusions: Families with combined annual income exceeding ₹2,50,000
Households with an income tax payer, regular government employee, or four-wheeler (excluding tractor)
documents_required: Maharashtra Domicile Certificate, Birth Certificate, or 15-Year-Old Ration Card
Yellow or Orange Ration Card (or Income Certificate up to ₹2.5 Lakh)
application_steps: Apply on the official Ladki Bahin portal (ladakibahin.maharashtra.gov.in), Nari Shakti Doot App, or nearest Anganwadi/Setu Suvidha Kendra.
Upload Domicile proof, Ration Card/Income proof, and signed Hamipatra (self-declaration).
Complete e-KYC verification for monthly DBT disbursement.
